systems_changed.change_summary: Haunt base bounty and growth rise 10% while Haunt HP and damage also rise 10%, making camps both richer and more punishing to clear.
driving_changes: Haunts base bounty and growth increased by 10%
Haunts HP and Damage output increased by 10%
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Off-lane farm is now the highest-value income on the map, but only for comps that clear grouped, chasing camps without bleeding HP. Weak-clear/single-target heroes fall further behind the AoE/sustain clearers, widening the coverage gap the KB already flagged.

systems_changed.change_summary: A three-part anti-snowball package: non-hero comeback gold cap rises 26%→30%, Haunted Souls secure up to 50% faster when behind (max at 20% NW gap), and the behind-multiplier now also feeds tick souls to the two poorest players.
driving_changes: Comeback gold from non-hero sources increased from a max of 26% to 30% (when behind by ~20% Net Worth)
Haunted Souls secure rate is now up to 50% faster than baseline based on how far behind you are in Net Worth compared to the enemy team's average (max rate at a 20% Net Worth gap)
The bonus NPC souls multiplier when behind now also increases tick souls for the 2 poorest players
systems_changed.effect_on_play: This directly reverses the KB's 'leads stick' read: losing teams now convert camp souls more reliably and get passive tick catch-up, so a farm lead is a soft lead. It rewards teams that keep farming from behind instead of conceding, and lengthens games.

systems_changed.change_summary: Baseline secure rate is 25% slower, but scales up to 50% faster than baseline the further behind you are in net worth.
driving_changes: Haunted Souls secure rate is now 25% slower
Haunted Souls secure rate is now up to 50% faster than baseline based on how far behind you are in Net Worth compared to the enemy team's average (max rate at a 20% Net Worth gap)
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Contested camp souls become a skill/timing check for the leader (slower baseline secure = easier to steal) and a gift for the trailing team. It makes camp contests less of a straight stat-check and more of a comeback lever.

systems_changed.change_summary: Breakables growth values drop 10%, while new Halloween Cauldrons (broken with Heavy Melee) drop Candy granting a temporary Sugar Rush buff.
driving_changes: With a Heavy Melee, break the cauldron to pick up a piece of Candy and stash it in your pocket for later... consume the candy to grant yourself a boost of energy with the temporary Sugar Rush buff
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Crate scaling is trimmed, so Heavy Melee crate routes pay slightly less late, but Cauldrons add a fresh Heavy Melee-gated pickup that rewards the same frontline/tank kits with a stashed tempo buff. Heavy Melee access stays a real economy skill.

systems_changed.change_summary: Healing Snacks heal rises from 10% to 14% max HP.
driving_changes: Healing Snacks heal increased from 10% Max HP to 14%
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Camps and extended off-lane routes are more survivable, reinforcing sustain bruisers and tanks who already clear Haunts; it slightly lowers the cost of contesting hubs and Buff Containers.

systems_changed.system: Movement / Steam Vents / tunnels / air drag
systems_changed.change_summary: Steam Vents are reworked to grant +150% stamina regen (from the KB's invisibility roams), tunnel move speed drops +70%→+50%, and the slow-to-air-drag ratio rises 0.35→0.5.
driving_changes: Steam Vents now increase stamina regeneration by 150%
Move speed in tunnels reduced from +70% to +50%
Move slow to air drag ratio increased from 0.35 to 0.5
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Vents shift from a stealth-gank tool to a stamina/kiting tool, cutting the free approach angle roamers had; tunnel rotations slow, tightening map tempo; and the higher air-drag ratio taxes flyers harder whenever they're slowed.

systems_changed.change_summary: The latest six heroes lose 'new' status, gaining normal ranked unlock requirements and becoming bannable.
driving_changes: Latest 6 heroes are no longer categorized as "new" anymore. This means they have normal hero unlocking requirements for ranked and can now be banned.
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Ranked draft can now suppress the strongest of the recent six, so their pick/win rates should compress toward the field; it also raises the barrier to entry on those kits in ranked.

tempo_shift.why: The comeback package (non-hero comeback gold 26%→30%, Haunted Souls securing up to 50% faster when behind, tick souls to the two poorest) plus trimmed breakable growth directly softens leads the KB said were sticking, giving trailing teams a farm-based path back. Richer-but-tougher Haunts reward sustained farming over early lane tempo.

archetype_effects.why: Heavy Melee Cauldrons add a new candy/Sugar Rush pickup and Healing Snacks 10%→14% makes camp chip damage cheaper to absorb.
Comeback gold 26%→30%, faster Haunted Souls secure when behind, and tick souls to the poorest give trailing scalers a real catch-up route.
Steam Vents reworked from invisibility to stamina regen removes the free approach, and tunnels +70%→+50% slows rotations.
Higher air-drag ratio (0.35→0.5) taxes flyers harder under slows, and slower tunnel speed blunts long-range repositioning.
Breakables growth -10% trims crate scaling, offset by Cauldron Heavy Melee value; net roughly flat.
Breakables growth -10% and slower tunnel rotations reduce the value of shoving-and-rotating over farming Haunts.

intent_read: Valve is deliberately re-opening the comeback valve it closed in prior patches: the multi-pronged behind-team package (gold cap, Haunted Souls secure, tick souls) plus trimmed breakable growth targets the 'leads stick' problem the KB flagged. The Haunt bounty/HP bump and Cauldrons push income further off-lane and toward Heavy Melee/AoE clearers, while the Steam Vent and tunnel changes pull back the free-roam gank tempo that made corridors so strong.
